Given the method now is `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (see `app/models/topic.rb`), this test will return false trivially on defaults (e.g., `embed_truncate` default false) and/or because `has_topic_embed?` is false, so the test name is misleading and not testing what it claims.
